title: c12 explores a new class: 2D implicit-solvent bonded amphiphiles (Cooke-Kremer-Deserno 3-bead lipids) that self-assemble into bilayers, with a membrane chemistry (precursor -> lipid at an existing bilayer)
summary: Material membranes made of bonded particles (cf. Q:bonded-particle-membrane). Loop 1: does a random lipid gas assemble bilayers and closed 2D vesicles; loop 2: autocatalytic membrane growth and division.
